items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nat and I became neighbors... We really became fast friends then and there... traveling around together and performing together and recording together.

ctx.x: I know who you're talking about, yeah.

Yeah. We went to a club called the Three Sixes, 666, and the trio was the Nat "King" Cole Trio. And the word was true. It blew our minds. The musicality and the beauty of this trio. The complex arrangements they played. Nat and that wonderful voice and what not. He was quite a pianist.
